status: prospective structural gate before any numeric altitude analysis

forbidden_operations: change the structural threshold after the gate

session_definition.rationale: source metadata states tags were programmed for nocturnal fixes; each Tag ID x local date is one candidate tracking night

structural_gate.decision: PASS if at least 5 Tag IDs have at least two >=50-fix local-date sessions

future_validation_boundary: A PASS only authorizes freezing a full vertical-validation contract; it does not authorize exploratory altitude inspection.
The full contract must fail closed if retained rows have missing/nonfinite Altitude values.
A FAIL cannot be rescued by lowering the >=50-fix threshold in this prospective family.
No alternate date grouping, tag subset, horizontal grid, or vertical endpoint may be selected after the structural result.
